title: Signed line module inverse image adjunction
statement: Under the ring and underlying-set unit presentations of lem-pur-signed-line-module-action-presentations, the specified module pullback has a natural isomorphism, after forgetting to abelian sheaves, with the constructed abelian inverse image of the underlying module. The isomorphism carries the module pullback adjunction unit to the abelian inverse-image unit. No equality of site object and morphism universes is required.

source.place: Tags 03D2, 03D3, 03EL and 0FNY; for derived localization use derived.tex Tags 06YU, 07A4 and 015F. Specialization of the Powers and duals paragraph of the current blueprint.

proof.text: Construct the module structure on each actual abelian inverse image by the preceding action theorem. Transfer the underlying abelian adjunction hom equivalence: a source semilinear map extends to a linear map because its scalar compatibility is tested on inverse-image units of a product. The unit and counit identities are inherited from the abelian adjunction. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies this construction with the specified module pullback and identifies the units.

proof_origin.place: Powers and duals, including unit, positive tensor recursion, evaluation, and unbounded derived action. The component proof is given below and in the attached Lean module.

theorem inverseImage_underlying_of_ring_presentation
    [(CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}).PreservesLeftKanExtensions F.op]
    [K.PreservesSheafification (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w})]
    [RepresentablyFlat F] [PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafPullback F (Type (max u v w)) J K)]
    (pr : SheafPullbackUnitPresentation (F := F)
      ((sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget RingCat.{max u v w})).obj A)
      ((sheafCompose K (CategoryTheory.forget RingCat.{max u v w})).obj B))
    (hr : pr.unit = (sheafCompose J (CategoryTheory.forget RingCat.{max u v w})).map φ) :
    ∃ e : pullback.{max u v w} φ ⋙ toSheaf B ≅
      toSheaf A ⋙ sheafPullback F AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w} J K,
      ∀ M : SheafOfModules.{max u v w} A,
        (toSheaf A).map ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction φ).unit.app M) ≫
          (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w} J K).map (e.hom.app M) =
            (sheafAdjunctionContinuous F AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w} J K).unit.app
              ((toSheaf A).obj M)
